correctness.rationale: Exact Jacobian differentiation over char2 gives a three-quadric ideal containing the determinant. Affine charts a,c,e≠0 identify Y with k[u,v,eta]/eta^2, their coordinate transitions give nilradical O_P2(-3), and the chart cover establishes no missed component. Height 3 makes the generators a regular sequence, giving Hilbert series (1+t)^3/(1-t)^3 and degree 8. The cubic is irreducible and satisfies R1+S2. A standalone stdlib GF2 checker confirms the key polynomial identities, a 15-pair Buchberger test, six products of extra minors, and 20 finite Hilbert checks, not used as an infinite proof.

The nontrivial square-zero module O_P2(-3), exact double multiplicity and Hilbert series supply a motivated intrinsic singular-scheme invariant in the exceptional characteristic. It is a complete natural classification rather than an arbitrary finite parameter slice.
